groups.analysis: Preview uses visited IDs to terminate repeated/cyclic attachment traversal; orders roots and attachment points, limits displayed children to authored capacity, and preserves unknown occupied items. Placement/depth are preview heuristics, not server attachment admission. Readiness compares desired catalogue-item set size to visible resolved roots and rejects failed/hidden parts. Duplicate roots could satisfy counts while another item is absent, but an actual duplicate-placeholder producer is not established; do not promote this abstract shape to a runtime finding.

Unbound mesh clone removes joint indices/weights and subtracts its rigid center while preserving morph targets; native finite subtraction can overflow for extreme coordinates, but no ordinary fitted producer is demonstrated. Worn items without skin are hidden. Canonical body extraction checks triangle layout and joint mapping; body surface coordinates reject nonfinite vertices and nonfinite/nonpositive total height before normalized coordinates. Native inverse-bind inversion/decomposition and raw normals/weights remain generator prerequisites; this caller alone does not establish their complete admission.

Candidate body morph/rig fit is prepared on a clone and inserted only after success; support models/designs are gathered before assigning one pending immutable task. Completed task result is cached, and cache protects pending/current keys. Clock wrapping may invert recency at u64 maximum: lifetime/API qualification only. Installing a new key despawns old parts, clears prior resolved/failed flags and sockets before replacement GPU availability, so no whole replacement transaction is implied. Failure removes the current fit key while retaining LastFit: connect to accepted RIGPP005/007/010 retained-key gaps, not a new unique finding. Unworn first anatomical placement is intentional; preserve withdrawn RIGPP004 qualification.
